<!-- page 528 -->
                                                                                                                                                    20.
*All teachers of Day Schools within Treaty Limits receive a minimum salary of $300 per annum from the Government and an addition of $12 per capita per annum
for all pupils over the number 25 up to the number of42, making a maximum salary of $504 where they have the full average attendance of pupils, namely, 42. It is
understood that the salaries above mentioned are supplemented by the different religious bodies under whose auspices the schools are conducted.
